cc:Work.dc:title: reconstruction-startup-delay
cc:Work.dc:description: June startup-delay experiment replotted from the original 0, 100 and 170 minute dawn calculations. Curves assume a 10 km altitude. Earlier first-reception delays are not measured startup times.
